description: Find Canli Capital research papers (strategy tests, killed candidates, literature reviews, feasibility protocols) by words in their titles and summaries. Use it to find a paper's slug, then read it with get_paper; to browse by subject instead, use list_topics.

query.description: Words to find in paper titles and summaries, for example 'momentum' or 'insider'.

name: search_research

outputSchema.description: rows are the matching papers, one per row in the order of columns; next says how to read one with get_paper.

title: Search research
